 Ukraine Premier League 
 Dynamo to face Shakhtar in the Premier league on November 8
 21.10.2026, 15:19 
 Print 
 Share: 
 The dates and kick-off times for the matches of Round 12 of the 2026/27 UPL Championship have been confirmed. The round will feature the Ukrainian Clasico, with Dynamo Kyiv facing Shakhtar Donetsk.
 The match will take place on Sunday, November 8. Kick-off is at 18:00.
 ROUND 12 
 November 6 (Friday) 
 Obolon — Livyi Bereh 13:00
 Polissia — Veres 15:30
 November 7 (Saturday) 
 Kharkiv — Karpaty 13:00
 Kudrivka — Chornomorets 13:00
 Epitsentr — Kryvbas 15:30
 November 8 (Sunday) 
 Zorya — LNZ 13:00
 Bukovyna — Kolos 15:30
 Shakhtar — Dynamo 18:00
